signatures.name: kraken_avoidance_in_risky
signatures.description: In risky blocks, agents click tiles whose underlying value is above the Kraken threshold more often than chance (~50% on a uniform grid).

signatures.name: value_directed_exploitation
signatures.description: Higher previous-click reward predicts smaller spatial distance to the next click (negative correlation): agents stay near rewarding tiles.

signatures.name: above_chance_reward
signatures.description: Mean observed reward exceeds the chance baseline of 50 (the grid mean), via the proportion of clicks with z>50.

signatures.name: within_block_learning
signatures.description: Within a block, observed reward (z) increases with click position: the agent learns where to fish as the block progresses.
